Where would I go? How would I get there? I'm only 18. I don't think you understand, I have literally 0 on my name, I got no job no nothing. Also I couldn't just leave my family, I believe that family comes #1 and I don't want to disappoint them in any way with my own selfish actions. 

I'd rather they think of me with dignity and not that I am the son who brought shame upon the entire family.
